entities.summary: Cesarina Monti, better known as Rina Monti and, sometimes, as Rina Monti Stella, was an Italian scientist. A biologist, physiologist, limnologist and zoologist, in 1907 she became the first woman to obtain a university chair in the Kingdom of Italy.
